scope: All records whose proposed condition atoms contain coexposure=sls_barrier_enhancement; only the exact pure signature is eligible for the pure SLS group.
eligibility_contract: The query molecule is the material whose absolute sensitization outcome is reported.
SLS is an actual pretreatment, vehicle, or co-exposure in the same experimental arm.
The record is a predictive induction/sensitization experiment, not a diagnostic elicitation study in already sensitized or selected allergic participants.
Relative-only effects, mixed SLS/no-SLS arms, controls, duplicate arms, and acronym false positives are excluded.
Composite signatures are retained as their exact signatures and never collapsed into the pure SLS group.

eligible_records.manual_reason: Query material tested in a human maximization repeat-insult patch test with explicit SLS pretreatment and an absolute negative sensitization outcome.
Nickel chloride tested by repeated human exposure in an explicit 0.1% SLS vehicle with an absolute positive sensitization outcome.
Query material tested in a human maximization study with an SLS-enhanced induction protocol and an absolute negative outcome.
Query material tested in a human maximization study using the stated SLS/patch protocol with an absolute negative outcome.
